features.statement: Page uses a dark theme with near-black navy background and light off-white text.
A single bright cyan accent color is used for buttons, initials, badges and highlights.
Primary and secondary buttons are fully rounded pills, in a filled accent and outlined pairing.
Hero has an uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow label inside a rounded outlined chip above the headline.
Large single H1 hero headline with centered subtitle and centered stats row beneath.
Clear h1→h2→h3 heading hierarchy with a large H1 and smaller H2s.
Uses semantic landmarks (nav, main, multiple sections) and minimal DOM with few wrappers, scripts and inline styles.
Typography uses only the system-ui font stack, with slightly larger 16px body text and looser line height.
Layout is a single centered column of stacked full-width sections, with grid used for card rows.
Content is presented as rows of three equal bordered cards with larger icons or avatars.
Cards place square-cropped images above text, with uniform sizing regardless of natural aspect ratio.
Avatars are circular dark discs with italic accent-colored initials, not photos or square tiles.
Larger card radii and pill shapes are used instead of square corners.
Separation relies on 1px borders and tonal panels, with no drop shadows.
Hero has a subtle radial colored glow as the only gradient decoration.
Each section heading is followed by a short explanatory subheading line.
Copy is concise and marketing-style, with rewritten taglines and a low word count.
Dedicated sign-up call-to-action panel with social login pill buttons and an email alternative.
Interface uses almost no icon glyphs, relying on text labels and initials; metadata like reply counts is plain text.
Header is a slim dark bar with a small logo and text navigation links, without a banner image.
Footer continues the dark page background with a thin top border and muted gray text links.
Images mostly have empty alt attributes, even for content photos, avatars and icons.
Badges such as 'NEW!' are rendered as small accent-colored pills placed before the name.
Styling uses few semantic class names, with no utility-framework classes or external stylesheets.
Head metadata is minimal, with only charset, viewport and description tags.
Inline emphasis and small text tags (b, strong, small) are used for secondary text.
